C0040.title: Minor Sentenced for Online Store Fraud via Fake Shipments
C0040.summary: On May 15, 2025, Jiangxi political and legal media reported a Yongxin County People’s Court case in which Wang, born in July 2007, opened an online store for steel materials and used fake shipment documents and photos to obtain an 8,800 yuan deposit. The court found Wang guilty of fraud and sentenced him to eight months in prison, suspended for one year, with a 2,000 yuan fine.
